Daily Quiz.question: ১) Hamlet was a prince of ____.
Daily Quiz.exp: Hamlet, in full Hamlet, Prince of Denmark, tragedy in five acts by William Shakespeare, written about 1599–1601 and published in a quarto edition in 1603 from an unauthorized text, with reference to an earlier play. Source: https://www.britannica.com/topic/Hamlet-by-Shakespeare

Daily Quiz.question: ২) Which one is the youngest daughter of the King Lear?
Daily Quiz.exp: The aging King Lear decides to divide his kingdom among his three daughters, allotting each a portion in proportion to the eloquence of her declaration of love. The hypocritical Goneril and Regan make grand pronouncements and are rewarded; Cordelia, the youngest daughter, who truly loves Lear, refuses to make an insincere speech to prove her love and is disinherited. Source: https://www.britannica.com/topic/King-Lear

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) In which play Shakespeare portrays a Jewish character?
Daily Quiz.exp: Shylock in Merchant of Venice was a Jewish moneylender. Source: https://www.britannica.com/topic/The-Merchant-of-Venice

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) ‘Miranda’ is a character created by-
Daily Quiz.exp: Miranda is a character from Shakespeare’s play “The Tempest”. Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) Michael, Raphael--these two characters are taken from-
Daily Quiz.exp: Michael and Raphael --these two characters are taken from John Milton’s Paradise Lost. Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) Agamemnon was the king of-
Daily Quiz.exp: Agamemnon, in Greek legend, king of Mycenae or Argos. He was the son (or grandson) of Atreus, king of Mycenae, and his wife Aërope and was the brother of Menelaus. Source: https://www.britannica.com/topic/Agamemnon-Greek-mythology

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) In play Doctor Faustus, who was the intermediary of the Devil?
Daily Quiz.exp: In Doctor Faustus, Marlowe retells the story of Faust, the doctor-turned-necromancer, who makes a pact with the devil in order to obtain knowledge and power. Both Doctor Faustus and Mephistopheles, who is the devil’s intermediary in the play, are subtly and powerfully portrayed. Source: https://www.britannica.com/topic/Doctor-Faustus-play

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) ‘Captain Bluntschli’- is a character taken from-
Daily Quiz.exp: ‘Captain Bluntschli’ is a character taken from Arms and the Man, a play by G. B Shaw.

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) “Robert Jordan” is a character created by-
Daily Quiz.exp: The character ‘Robert Jordan’ is taken from  Earnest Hemingway’s novel For Whom the Bell Tolls. Source: https://www.britannica.com/topic/For-Whom-the-Bell-Tolls-novel-by-Hemingway

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) In Aurther Miller’s play “Death of Salesman”, whose tragic death has been portrayed?
Daily Quiz.exp: Willy Loman is the protagonist of this play and his misery and tragic death was portrayed in the play. Source: https://www.britannica.com/topic/Death-of-a-Salesman
